english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for expressing a different opinion or belief.

exampleSentences.english: I disagree with what you’re saying.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 m4 tung4 ji3 nei5 gam3 joeng2 gong2

english.note: Use this when a person disagrees with an opinion, suggestion, or statement.

exampleSentences.english: I differ with you; I don't agree with doing that.
